statement: Opening setup: voidinator bottom row, 2 poisonic elders and a stormcaller on second platform, 4 party starters (level to 10 trait A), 3 krakens and a frozone on top

creator: nocturne
statement: Always summon 10 waves at a time because damage benefits from longer waves

creator: nocturne
statement: Level poisonic elders to 10 selecting traits A then B

creator: nocturne
statement: Level Stormcaller to 10 with trait B each time for crit chance on all towers

creator: nocturne
statement: Level Kraken towers to 10 with traits B then A; always keep one B trait on Krakens

creator: nocturne
statement: Level Frozone to 10 with trait A each time

creator: nocturne
statement: Level Voidinator to 10 with trait B for damage and mostly attack speed to remove all mob special abilities

creator: nocturne
statement: Around wave 50 summon three more poisonic elders on platform below initial ones and level to 10 with same traits

creator: nocturne
statement: Ignore extra poisonic on top row; it was placed due to a glitch

creator: nocturne
statement: Level to 15: party starters trait A, poisonics trait A (all five, top row tricky), krakens A, frozone A, stormcaller B

creator: nocturne
statement: Level voidinator to 15 with trait B if points allow; otherwise wait until others are 20 since it is expensive

creator: nocturne
statement: Level to 20: party starters trait A, poisonic elders trait B, krakens and frozone A, stormcaller B

creator: nocturne
statement: At end of wave 120 when only bosses remain, finish defensive line: four more krakens, a frozone, then last two krakens

creator: nocturne
statement: Last two towers cost 750k and almost 2 million points; summon what you can and add them later

creator: nocturne
statement: Level everything to 20 with same traits even if last two towers are not placed; finish them afterwards

creator: nocturne
statement: Level to 25: party starters B, poisonic elders B, stormcallers B; five B traits on stormcaller gives 100% crit on all towers

creator: nocturne
statement: Krakens and Frozones to 25 with trait A each time

creator: nocturne
statement: Kraken level 25 is expensive; work on it slowly while pushing to wave 200

creator: nocturne
statement: If everything is 25 level party starters to 30 with trait B for more damage

creator: nocturne
statement: Level voidinator to 20 with trait B for more damage

creator: nocturne
statement: Around wave 180 use hunter talent Stop Right There to slow mobs and keep them near damage towers; set auto attack

creator: nocturne
statement: Run takes about 2 hours to reach last few mobs of wave 200

creator: nocturne
statement: With 9-10 mobs left sell Krakens and Frozones from the left; keep three Krakens and one Frozone on the right

creator: nocturne
statement: Place four more party starters below initial (one trait A and four B); summon three to four more poisonic elders

creator: nocturne
statement: Level new towers to 25 using same traits as before

creator: nocturne
statement: With three enemies left and total HP below 540 trillion sell Frozone and two Krakens at top and replace Frozone under bosses leaving one Frozone and one Kraken

creator: nocturne
statement: Then sell all poisonic elders

creator: nocturne
statement: Summon 9 to 11 more Stormcallers depending on affordability; more means more damage

creator: nocturne
statement: Start with eight to nine stormcallers and level them before placing last two expensive towers

creator: nocturne
statement: Level all stormcallers to 25 with trait A; level 30 on a few adds damage
